}}'''Wallein''' is an ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' [[Wavemistress]] and one of the [[First Twelve]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wallein din Onill}}

== Activities ==
She attends the meeting of the First Twelve with [[Rand al'Thor]]'s ambassador [[Logain Ablar]]. Near the end of the meeting [[Cemeille din Selaan Long Eyes]] interrupts with the news of the [[Amayar]] committing mass suicide.{{Ref/book|11|22}}
